capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Motor1: 111 kWh gross / 107 kWh net on the Twin Motor (2025 US trims are Twin Motor and Twin Motor Performance). Wikipedia agrees.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Motor1: 107 kWh net; Wikipedia/EV Database agree.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: InsideEVs: the 2026 EX90 moves from a 400 V system to 800 V, so 2025 is 400 V.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Volvo US EX90 support article, read only as a search excerpt (volvocars.com 403): preconditioning starts automatically when a DC fast charger is the navigation destination and can also be started manually in the charging view. Applied to every EX90 year; nothing shows a change after the 800 V update.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs/Electrifying: 2025 peak 250 kW (10-80% about 30 min). Motor1 agrees.

ac_max_kw.notes: Motor1: 11 kW onboard charger (0-100% in at least 10 h). Market not stated; the Polestar US page lists 11 kW on the sibling pack.
